title: NASA Artemis II Crew Concludes Historic 10-Day Lunar Flyby & Splashes Down in Pacific
summary: Artemis II crew (Wiseman, Glover, Koch, Hansen) completes 252,756-mile lunar flyby, breaking Apollo 13 distance record at 252,757 miles.

blocks.content: NASA's 4-person **Artemis II crew** safely splashed down off San Diego on April 11, 2026, after completing a historic 10-day lunar flyby aboard the Orion capsule 'Integrity'.

items: **Record Distance**: Reached 2,52,757 miles (4,06,773 km) from Earth, breaking Apollo 13's 56-year-old human spaceflight distance record.
**Firsts**: Victor Glover (1st person of color beyond LEO), Christina Koch (1st woman to Moon's vicinity), Jeremy Hansen (1st Canadian in deep space).
